entities.name: Kelsinko
entities.description: Settlement of humans and elves deep within Fyndhorn on Terisiare, at the ruins of Citanul, sunk by the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who cast the World Spell to end the Ice Age.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell cast by Freyalise to end the Ice Age, followed by the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Flood that sank Kelsinko and most of Fyndhorn.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Mage who led a team to hold back the sea and was among the last to leave Kelsinko.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Led Kelsinko refugees west to Yavimaya.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: Led Kelsinko refugees west to Yavimaya.

events.summary: Kelsinko sinks beneath the sea during the Flooding of Terisiare after the World Spell.
events.quote: Kelsinko sank beneath the sea during the Flooding of Terisiare that followed the World Spell

events.summary: Jaya Ballard leads a team of mages to hold back the sea but eventually fails.
events.quote: Jaya Ballard led a team of mages to try to keep the waters of the sea at bay, but eventually failed

events.summary: Refugees from Kelsinko flee west to Yavimaya, led by Kaysa and Jaeuhl Carthalion.
events.quote: Refugees from Kelsinko headed west to Yavimaya

events.summary: Jaya is among the last out of the city and sees the first waves wash over the plaza.
events.quote: Jaya was one of the last ones out of the city

relations.quote: Kelsinko was a settlement deep within Fyndhorn on Terisiare
